component.name: oshot
component.summary: Take a screenshot and extract its text on the fly

description.p: oshot is a lightweight screenshot overlay: select a region of the screen and extract its text with Tesseract OCR, decode QR codes and barcodes with ZBar, annotate it, then copy or save it.

ul.li: Text extraction (OCR) in any language Tesseract has a model for
Annotations: arrows, lines, rectangles, circles, numbered counters, text and freehand drawing
Works on X11 and Wayland, with multiple monitors
